top_signals.title: U.S. raises Mastercard, Citigroup China market access in bilateral Bangkok talks, official says
top_signals.summary: The U.S. raised market access issues for Mastercard and Citigroup in China during bilateral meetings in Bangkok this week, a U.S. Treasury official says.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Coffee’s Coming Glut May Not Be Enough to Calm Volatile Prices
top_signals.summary: After years of shortages, the world is finally getting more coffee. The question is how much of it will reach the exchange warehouses that underpin prices across the industry.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Older Americans feel less of the affordability crunch. How that could affect the midterm elections
top_signals.summary: Younger Americans face higher inflation and housing costs than baby boomers, widening the affordability divide ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Why Trump and the GOP's billion-dollar midterm blitz isn’t working
top_signals.summary: Trump-aligned groups and Elon Musk have poured hundreds of millions into the midterm election, but the GOP spending surge has barely moved polls or the map.
